name: Mngwa
description: A large, grey-brindled mystery cat reported from the coastal regions of Tanzania and Zanzibar, East Africa, described as significantly larger than a lion with tabby-like markings and held responsible for a series of human fatalities investigated by British officials in the 1920s.

aliases.name: Nunda
aliases.meaning: Fierce animal; cruel man; something heavy

aliases.name: Nunda, Eater of People
aliases.meaning: Fierce man-eating creature (from the fairy tale collected by Steere, 1870)

origin: Reported from the coastal regions of mainland Tanzania and the island of Zanzibar; tradition associated with Swahili-speaking peoples of the East African coast.
